g.text: Use the Dehejia–Wahba RE74 subset: 185 randomized treated observations and 260 randomized controls.
RE78 is real 1978 earnings measured in 1982 U.S. dollars in the source documentation.
Welch standard error + large-sample normal interval + seeded percentile bootstrap + label-permutation diagnostic.
Generate a 0–4,000 frontier in 100-dollar increments; report point-estimate headroom and bootstrap exceedance.
Thresholds are scenarios, not observed training costs or validated modern corporate L&D break-even values.
